def test_any_int():
    # Valid cases: one value equals sum of the other two
    assert any_int(5, 2, 7) == True    # 5 + 2 == 7
    assert any_int(3, 2, 2) == False   # no combination sums
    assert any_int(3, -2, 1) == True   # 3 + (-2) == 1
    assert any_int(-3, -2, -5) == True # -3 + (-2) == -5
    assert any_int(0, 0, 0) == True    # 0 + 0 == 0

    assert any_int(1, 2, 3.0) == False
    assert any_int("3", 3, 6) == False
    assert any_int(None, 1, 1) == False
    assert any_int(True, 1, 2) == False  # bool is technically int subclass

    print("All tests passed!")
